I have some formal schooling, so I understand that applying a little chemical fertilizer helps my sorghum yield. I will put DAP at planting and some urea later, and I will also spread manure from my cattle as I do every year. I use my own saved seed because improved sorghum is not common here, and my family will manage all the work on this small plot ourselves.
